# Plain-list cases: <name> <file> <line>:<col> <command>...
# Point starts at <line>:<col> (the column in characters: point before
# that character, Neovim's cursor on it). Each command is the key's
# command in Emacs (scripts/emacs-parity/lists.el) and the action the
# key runs in org.nvim (tests/spec/emacs_lists_parity_spec.lua):
#   M-RET      org-meta-return          meta_return (Insert mode, at point)
#   M-S-RET    org-insert-todo-heading  meta_shift_return (Insert mode)
#   M-left     org-metaleft             meta_left
#   M-right    org-metaright            meta_right
#   M-S-left   org-shiftmetaleft        shift_meta_left
#   M-S-right  org-shiftmetaright       shift_meta_right
#   M-up       org-metaup               meta_up
#   M-down     org-metadown             meta_down
#   S-left     org-shiftleft            shift_left
#   S-right    org-shiftright           shift_right
#   S-up       org-shiftup              shift_up
#   S-down     org-shiftdown            shift_down
#   C-c-       org-ctrl-c-minus         ctrl_c_minus
#   C-c*       org-ctrl-c-star          ctrl_c_star
#   C-cC-c     org-ctrl-c-ctrl-c        context_action
#   C-c^<k>    org-sort, answering k    ctrl_c_caret, choosing k in the menu
#   C-u        a prefix argument (C-u, a count of 4) for the next command
#   ins:<text> insert <text> at point (to show where M-RET left it)
#   L<l>:<c>   move point
# The output is the buffer after the commands and "@ <line>", point's line.

# Inserting items (M-RET, M-S-RET)
insert-end          basic.org     3:9   M-RET ins:new
insert-mid          basic.org     3:5   M-RET ins:X
insert-after-bullet basic.org     3:2   M-RET ins:new
insert-last         basic.org     4:10  M-RET ins:new
insert-nested       nested.org    4:9   M-RET ins:new
insert-parent       nested.org    1:3   M-RET ins:new
insert-ordered      ordered.org   2:9   M-RET ins:new
insert-cb-ordered   ordered.org   2:9   M-S-RET ins:new
insert-paren-bol    paren.org     2:0   M-RET ins:new
insert-cb-item      checkbox.org  2:10  M-RET ins:new
insert-cb-shift     checkbox.org  2:10  M-S-RET ins:new
insert-desc         desc.org      1:18  M-RET ins:Term
insert-blank        blank.org     3:5   M-RET ins:new
insert-multi-split  multi.org     2:8   M-RET ins:X
insert-multi-end    multi.org     3:12  M-RET ins:new
insert-before-text  ends.org      2:3   M-RET ins:new

outdent-child       nested.org    2:2   M-left

outdent-parent      nested.org    3:2   M-left
indent-ordered      ordered.org   2:0   M-right
outdent-ordered     ordered.org   4:3   M-left
indent-multi        multi.org     4:0   M-right

# Moving items (M-up/down)
move-down           basic.org     3:0   M-down

item-next-last      nested.org    4:4   S-down

# Bullets (C-c -, S-left/right on the bullet)

# Items and headings (C-c *, C-c - off a list). C-u C-c * starts on the
# list's first line: from a later item Emacs marks that item only
# (org-mark-element) and, when items follow it, mangles the next one
# (org-toggle-heading narrows to one character past the region).
item-to-heading     basic.org     3:0   C-c*
parent-to-heading   nested.org    1:0   C-c*
multi-to-heading    multi.org     1:0   C-c*
list-to-subtree     nested.org    1:0   C-u C-c*
multi-to-subtree    multi.org     1:0   C-u C-c*
heading-to-item     basic.org     1:0   C-c-
text-to-item        basic.org     6:0   C-c-
para-to-item        ends.org      3:0   C-c-

# Sorting (C-c ^)

sort-numeric        sort.org      7:0   C-c^n

sort-ordered        sort.org      18:0  C-c^a
